PRODUCT BRIEF / 01

Earlier signals.
Better interventions.

PassOrFail.ai helps course instructors identify at-risk students while there is still time to act.

01

Problem

Educators often discover struggling students after critical intervention windows have closed. Early academic and behavioral signals exist, but they are fragmented across systems and difficult to interpret.

02

Primary user

IN
Course instructor

Manages 30–200 learners across one or more courses.

03

MVP outcomes

  • 1Prioritized student risk queue
  • 2Transparent contributing factors
  • 3Actionable intervention recommendations
